title: Build add-to-shopping-list sheet UI
description: Add the sheet view that lists existing shopping lists, handles catalog-loading and empty states, and collects new-list input before delegating commits to the service.
acceptance_criteria: `AddToShoppingListSheet` presents inside a `NavigationStack` with the specified title and Cancel action.
The sheet shows loading, new-list, existing-list, and empty-state branches per the spec.
Selecting a list commits immediately, while Create New uses the validated alert flow and surfaces write/read errors without dismissing.

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/AddToShoppingListSheet.swift` with: NavigationStack + "Add to shopping list" title + Cancel toolbar button; catalog-loading branch (ProgressView + "Loading aisles…" row); main list with "New list" section (Label + plus.circle.fill icon, opens create-new alert) and conditional "Existing lists" section (empty-state omitted per spec); append-to-existing flow calling `AddToShoppingListService.append` with error alert (Try again / Cancel, no sheet dismiss); create-new flow calling `AddToShoppingListService.create` with duplicate-name re-presentation matching the 0007 pattern; `onSuccess` callback for overlay confirmation to be wired upstream; `onAppear` + `onChange(of: catalog.isLoaded)` to load list URLs after catalog is ready. `xcodegen generate` run to register the file; `xcodebuild` confirms BUILD SUCCEEDED.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads still needed: (1) wire `RecipeBottomBar` to accept `recipe: Recipe?` + `scale: RecipeScale` and present this sheet; (2) pass `parsedRecipe` and `currentScale` from `RecipeDetailSheet` down to `RecipeBottomBar`; (3) add confirmation overlay in `RecipeDetailSheet` on `onSuccess` callback; (4) `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor` + collapsible free-text header in `ShoppingListDetailView` (per spec). These are separate beads in the feature tree.
handoff_summary.risks: The `onSuccess` callback delivers `(itemCount, listName)` to the caller — the confirmation overlay is not part of this sheet and must be implemented in `RecipeDetailSheet` or `RecipeBottomBar`. Downstream bead authors must wire that callback. The duplicate-name re-presentation relies on SwiftUI dismissing + re-showing the alert in the same run-loop batch; matches exact pattern used in `ShoppingListsView` (0007).
handoff_summary.next_action: Wire `RecipeBottomBar` to accept `recipe: Recipe?` + `scale: RecipeScale` and present `AddToShoppingListSheet`; pass `parsedRecipe` / `currentScale` from `RecipeDetailSheet`; add `onSuccess` overlay confirmation.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Downstream beads touching `RecipeBottomBar.swift` and `RecipeDetailSheet.swift` will extend the bottom-bar wiring; no file-level conflicts with this bead's output.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `onSuccess: (Int, String) -> Void` callback (item count + list display name) so the confirmation overlay lives in `RecipeDetailSheet`, keeping the sheet itself self-contained. Error alert leaves the sheet open per spec ("Don't dismiss"). Duplicate-name re-presentation mirrors `ShoppingListsView`'s exact pattern (set `duplicateNameError = true` then `showNewListAlert = true` inside the button action).
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests in scope for this bead (UI shell only); the service logic tested by a downstream tester bead. View-level acceptance criteria (loading state, empty state, cancel, create-new alert, error alert) are verifiable via UI tests or manual review.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The `onSuccess` callback is a closure — callers must store item count and list name in `@State` to drive the overlay; no built-in toast mechanism is provided by this sheet.

conflict_risks: Downstream beads touching `RecipeBottomBar.swift` and `RecipeDetailSheet.swift` will extend the bottom-bar wiring; no file-level conflicts with this bead's output.

execution_history.summary: Created `AddToShoppingListSheet.swift` — a SwiftUI sheet view that lists existing shopping lists, handles catalog-loading and empty states, validates and creates new lists via the alert flow, and delegates all append logic to `AddToShoppingListService`. Build verified with `xcodebuild BUILD SUCCEEDED`.
